children.value: > Fact From Story: Despite the popularity and growing influence of far-right creators online, Republican candidates have historically failed to engage young voters on social media, if they try at all.
> > Fact From Story: As the 2024 election approaches, Republican candidates may again fall behind in mobilizing voters on social media platforms.
> > > Fact From Story: Republican candidates have neglected to adopt the digital fluency required to secure the youth vote.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone is unable to do something, they are likely to fail.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The failure to mobilize voters decreases the odds of winning an election.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If one is unable to do something, they will often fail to do it.
